description: This file declares the interface for the PUSCH decoder in a 3GPP LTE/NR communication system, including configuration parameters, core decoding method, and softbit handling.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_decoder
classes.description: Interface class for decoding PUSCH codewords, recovering UL-SCH transport blocks, and managing softbit input.

methods.name: new_data
methods.description: Initializes decoding with provided transport block buffer, retransmission buffer, notifier, and configuration; returns a buffer for softbit input.

methods.name: set_nof_softbits
methods.description: Sets the expected number of softbits for the codeword, enabling early decoding before full reception.
